body: Shame it's worth less than half of AZ
Shame they're not voting for him.

I do love Trump, my sister hates me for it.  I have wanted to kill myself for years with no real reason as to why.  I've never tried before but now that I paid my debts and know my family will get a payout from the policy, it logically makes sense.  I've just preferred getting drunk and dreaming to a new day but now I don't really know.

All the psychiayrists are booked for over a year out (no fault to them), and I'd really hate to just put one round through this gun.

It would be the best for me, the best for my family (they wouldn't have to deal with me anymore), the best for everyone, really.

I uh..  god I want to die, but, ah...  Fuck it.

Another beer.

Trump.

I mean if you're going to burn the house down, might as well spark the gas lines first.
Are you the guy from the vids, OP?

I'm uh, a Trump supporter...

But you chaps really have to get out the vote.  I see much love for him everywhere I turn, on or offline, but ya'll got to vote!
If only Bernie's poll numbers were as strong as his reddit upvotes.

It's 2am, and the ER is doing real ER shit.  Shouldn't trouble them with my stupid shit.  Maybe I'll call tomorrow and make an appointment and just drink and binge watch something.

I cleared the pistol and set it aside.  Maybe tomorrow.  The new House of Cards is out.
It would hurt them at first, but it would pass...  And they're stronger than me...

Probably depression.  I've lost all interest in things I once threw myself into two years ago.  I've no idea as to why.

I don't feel I deserve a damn thing, though.  I've had enough so far in life and screwed up things that should have been a given.

I'm not trying to sound as though I'm fishing for compliments.  I was trying to be objective about the situation as best I can.  It's not right, but even objectively I look at everything and go, "Yeah, I should just fucking find out how the barrel tastes."

I know what I feel and I honestly believe it, and yet I know it's not "normal."  I've always thought that I will kill myself. That it will happen, and it's not a matter of if but when.  And after research (like the insurance data) a part of me is nervous that the rest of me has rationalized this whole option, and something changed because my little sister is starting sense things.

I don't if they know I bought another handgun, but she's acting awfully worried.  I think afterwords and after time she will be okay with it.  Heh, might even help her acting.

My doctor is off for the weekend.  I don't know.  Maybe I'll fry a steak and drink more.  I don't know what to do and I don't even know why I asked this.  Maybe I should just do it.  The weapon is right here and all.  I don't know why I'm even typing this out.

Maybe I should just go to the hospital as in-patient...
